steps: S V Y A C F I K M P S U W has diffs 3,3,2,2 repeating
check_code:
opts={'A':'UCP','B':'VCP','C':'VCQ','D':'VBP'}
def ok(f):
    s='S%sYA%sFIKM%sSUW'%tuple(f)
    p=[ord(c)-64 for c in s]
    d=[(p[i+1]-p[i])%26 for i in range(len(p)-1)]
    return d==[([3,3,2,2][i%4]) for i in range(len(d))]
r=[k for k in 'ABCD' if ok(opts[k])]
assert r==['B']
